pages.title: Danmaku Fire
pages.text: A doll can fire danmaku with a Star Wand or an Iron Dagger. Once the order is given, one doll fires at the target and then hands the attack on to the next.

Range and aim$(br2)Shots are led for their own flight time, so a target that keeps moving is still hit, and they carry up to 48 blocks.$(br2)Turn-based?$(br2)An attack order walks down your dolls one after another instead of firing them all at once.
